Summary: Nexus now reports the verified missing download size for each product update.
Changes: Product cards show the bytes missing from the verified local package store instead of the complete installed size.
Missing bytes are recalculated after catalog refresh, retry, install, and cache cleanup.
Product lifecycle handling no longer blocks the main window while companion processes are being reconciled.
CompatibilityNotes: This is a test-signed Preview build and retains the current product and cache identities.
MigrationNotes: Existing installations, activations, rollback state, and package cache remain valid.
